params.name: name
params.description: Unique name for the new volume.

params.name: capacity
params.description: Capacity of the volume in GB.

params.name: owner
params.description: User ID that owns this volume. Creates the user if they do not exist.

params.name: mpCount
params.description: Initial number of metadata partitions. Defaults to 3.

params.name: dpCount
params.description: Initial number of data partitions. Defaults to 10.

params.name: replicaNum
params.description: Replication factor for data partitions. Defaults to 3.

params.name: followerRead
params.description: Whether follower replicas can serve read requests.

params.name: enablePosixAcl
params.description: Whether POSIX ACL is enabled for this volume.

params.name: volType
params.description: Volume type. 0 for replicated, 1 for erasure coded.

params.name: qosEnable
params.description: Whether QoS (quality of service) throttling is enabled.

items.docs: Creates a new CubeFS volume with the specified configuration. Volumes are the top-level namespace for storing data. When created, CubeFS allocates 10 data partitions and 3 metadata partitions by default. If no user matching the owner ID exists, a new user is automatically created with that ID. The volume can be configured for replication or erasure coding.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the volume to retrieve.

params.name: authKey
params.description: MD5 of the owner's user ID for authentication.

items.docs: Returns detailed information about a specific volume including its name, owner, capacity, replication configuration, data partition list, metadata partition list, and current status.

params.name: keywords
params.description: Substring filter for volume names.

items.docs: Returns a list of all volumes in the cluster. The results can be filtered by keyword to match volume names containing the specified substring.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the volume to update.

params.name: authKey
params.description: MD5 of the owner's user ID for authentication.

params.name: capacity
params.description: New capacity in GB for the volume.

params.name: followerRead
params.description: Enable or disable follower reads.

params.name: replicaNum
params.description: New replication factor for the volume.

params.name: enablePosixAcl
params.description: Enable or disable POSIX ACL.

items.docs: Updates configuration parameters for an existing volume including capacity, replication settings, QoS parameters, follower read policy, and access control settings.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the volume to delete.

params.name: authKey
params.description: MD5 of the owner's user ID for authentication.

items.docs: Marks a volume for deletion. The volume is first logically deleted by setting its status to deleted, then all data and metadata partitions are asynchronously removed via periodic tasks. Erasure-coded volumes can only be deleted when their used size is 0.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the volume to expand.

params.name: authKey
params.description: MD5 of the owner's user ID for authentication.

params.name: capacity
params.description: New capacity in GB. Must be greater than current capacity.

items.docs: Expands the storage capacity of a volume to the specified size in GB. The new capacity must be larger than the current capacity. CubeFS will automatically allocate additional data partitions as needed.
